user.title: Quebec school calendar
user.description: Add a calendar source. The URL can point to a PDF, an iCalendar file, or a school website page. More sources can be added later from the options.

data_description.source_url: Leave empty to create the calendar without a source and add one later.
data_description.source_type: "School website" automatically looks for calendar documents in the page.
data_description.enable_ocr: Only useful for a scanned PDF with no text layer. Grid calendars do not need it. Requires tesseract and poppler, which are not present in Home Assistant OS or Container.

error.invalid_url: The address must be a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL.
error.not_a_calendar: This document does not look like a school calendar: no holiday, pedagogical day, spring break or term start was found. Check the address. If it is a scanned PDF, enable OCR.

abort.already_configured: This calendar source is already configured.

init.title: School calendar options
init.description: What would you like to do?

menu_options.feed: Publish to an external calendar app

feed.title: iCalendar feed
feed.description:
Subscribe your phone to this address to see the school calendar in its Calendar app.

**{url}**

On iPhone: Settings > Apps > Calendar > Accounts > Add Account > Other > Add Subscribed Calendar.

This address acts as a password: anyone who has it can read the calendar. Access is read-only. Rotate the secret if you shared it by mistake, which will invalidate existing subscriptions.

data_description.enable_ocr: Only useful for a scanned PDF with no text layer. Grid calendars do not need it. Requires tesseract and poppler, which are not present in Home Assistant OS or Container.

error.invalid_url: The address must be a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL.
error.not_a_calendar: This document does not look like a school calendar: no holiday, pedagogical day, spring break or term start was found. Check the address. If it is a scanned PDF, enable OCR.

abort.no_sources: No source is configured for this calendar.

add_source.name: Add source
add_source.description: Adds a calendar source to an existing calendar. The calendar is reloaded and events are fetched immediately.

config_entry_id.name: Calendar
config_entry_id.description: Calendar to modify. Required when several calendars are configured.

source_url.name: Source URL
source_url.description: Address of the PDF, iCalendar file, or school website page.

source_type.name: Source type
source_type.description: Determines whether the address is a direct document or a page to crawl.

remove_source.name: Remove source
remove_source.description: Removes a calendar source. The calendar is reloaded.

config_entry_id.name: Calendar
config_entry_id.description: Calendar to modify. Required when several calendars are configured.

source_id.name: Source
source_id.description: Identifier or URL of the source to remove. The identifier is listed in the status sensor attributes.

refresh_calendar.name: Refresh calendar
refresh_calendar.description: Forces an immediate fetch of all sources.

config_entry_id.name: Calendar
config_entry_id.description: Calendar to refresh. All calendars when omitted.

parse_pdf.name: Parse PDF
parse_pdf.description: Parses a local PDF and returns the detected events without adding them to the calendar. Useful to validate a document before adding it as a source.

config_entry_id.name: Calendar
config_entry_id.description: Calendar whose settings are used for parsing. Required when several calendars are configured.

file_path.name: File path
file_path.description: Path to the PDF. Its directory must be listed in allowlist_external_dirs.
